descriptions.text: Enchanted crossbow bolt. The Danforth. This bolt does no physical damage. However, anyone hit with it will be anchored in place for (two seconds × your Crossbow skill level). More specifically, the area of their body that is hit with the bolt will be anchored in place. If they happen to be moving at the time, the physics involved might get a little . . . messy.

beats.headline: Sparkly, from a hot-dog bag
beats.text: Donut's legendary Lorena Bobbitt box comes as a giant 7-11 hot dog bag. The wrapper drips imaginary blood as it peels back on a quiver of glittering crossbow bolts, about ten of them. They're so sparkly, says Donut. Carl snatches one before they disappear and reads it: whatever part of a body it hits is anchored in place, and if the target is moving, the physics get messy. Hell yeah, says Carl, and asks her Crossbow skill. She tells him he is ruining it.

beats.headline: The shot not taken
beats.text: The plan for the start of the second heat has a Danforth bolt in it. Donut's Scorpion's Bite mount forms on her back with Katia's crossbow, and the glowing bolt locks into place on its own with an ominous click. They hope to get it back; there are only ten. At the green light she will root Rapture, the Lady Dominators' driver, in place, and Chiyome's giant bear will smash the car out from under her. Donut has the shot. At the green light she tenses to fire, and pauses: a long tank-like tube has popped out of Team Sparkles' bush, aimed at the muscle car in front of them. It fires, and the car goes straight up into the air.

beats.headline: Holding a god
beats.text: Emberus, enraged and growing, is rearing back with a flaming ball in his hand when Donut zaps into the room by one of Lucia's loop-de-loop traps, the crossbow cocked on her back. Katia's Bolt of Ophiotaurus goes into one smouldering eye socket. A second bolt goes into the other: one of her ten Danforth bolts, to hold the god in place. His yellow invulnerability glow winks off. He is vulnerable for fifteen seconds, and he cannot move.
